title: Half the predrilled holes weren’t lined up
text: Half the predrilled holes weren’t lined up. Every single hole on the bottom of the three holders was not lined up with the side holes. I had to use my own drill with a very teeny drill bit, and drill my own hole. The bamboo on the bottom piece is very brittle so we’ll see if my holes hold up. I really love the size of this unit. However, each section is freestanding. There is no way to lock the units together. They just kind of sit on top of each other, hoping no one knocks it over. The plastic pieces fit in the grooves perfectly, they are lined with a piece of film that protects them from scratches. It’s an extreme pain in the butt to get the film off. I doubt I would order this again, although I really do like the look of it
